title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Position Overview**


Citi is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database\-as\-a\-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi\-region banking systems.


**Responsibilities \& Requirements**
  

**1\. Enterprise Database Architecture \& Technical Strategy**
  

Architect, design, and deliver end\-to\-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis).
  

Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high\-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments.
  

Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero\-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
  

**2\. Modernization, DBaaS \& Cloud Enablement**
  

Lead migration initiatives from legacy on\-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS).
  

Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling.
  

Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re\-platform and refactor applications for cloud\-native persistence layers.
  

**3\. High Availability, Replication \& Scalability Engineering**
  

Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets \& Sharded Clusters).
  

Establish cross\-region and multi\-data\-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission\-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
  

**4\. Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning \& Diagnostics**
  

Spearhead deep\-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems.
  

Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks.
  

Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
  

**5\. Security, Vulnerability Management \& Access Control**
  

Enforce end\-to\-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in\-transit, and privileged access controls.
  

Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non\-compliant instances across the fleet.
  

Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role\-based access control (RBAC).
  

**6\. Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD**
  

Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub).
  

Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation.
  

Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self\-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
  

**7\. Continuity of Business (COB) \& Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  

Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills.
  

Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point\-in\-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site\-level disasters.
  

Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
  

**8\. Governance, Risk, Audit \& Regulatory Compliance**
  

Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments.
  

Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates.
  

Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
  

**9\. Technical Leadership, Mentorship \& Vendor Engagement**
  

Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams.
  

Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures.
  

Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
  

**10\. Required Qualifications, Experience \& Certifications**  

**Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Experience**: 12\+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3\+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large\-scale, enterprise financial services environment.
  

**Core Technical Competencies:**
  

In\-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12\+, Patroni, Connection Pooling).
  

Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures.
  

Demonstrated hands\-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform.
  

Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols.
  

Certifications (Preferred):
  

Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist
  

AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional
  

PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional
  

MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional
  

Key Leadership \& Soft Skills
  

Proven track record of managing high\-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion.
  

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
  

Strong ownership mindset, problem\-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

title: System Administrator I
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
### **Role Overview:**


The System Administrator I is responsible for the administration, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure within a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. This role ensures high availability, performance, and security of systems across on\-premises and cloud environments.  

The incumbent will manage incident resolution, system maintenance, network configurations, and cloud operations, while delivering high\-quality support to internal stakeholders and customers. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and adherence to operational and security standards.### **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Incident \& Service Management  

* Monitor, triage, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs, ensuring timely escalation where required.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Document resolutions, root causes, and updates in accordance with operational processes.
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem and Windows server environments.


2\. System Monitoring \& Infrastructure Management  

* Proactively monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog,PagerDuty).
* Respond to alerts across critical, warning, and error thresholds.
* Perform system upgrades, patch management, and scheduled maintenance activities.
* Manage and optimize server resources including CPU, memory, and storage capacity.


3\. Network Administration  

* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network connectivity including static, dynamic, and failover tunnels.
* Perform routing updates, ASA licensing activities, and IP whitelisting tasks.
* Execute network security tasks such as IP blocking (shunning) and tunnel resets.


4\. Identity \& Access Management (IAM)  

* Administer Active Directory (AD) user accounts, group memberships, and access policies.

* Support identity synchronization between AD and Okta environments.
* Provision and maintain internal and customer user accounts in alignment with security policies.


5\. Database Administration Support  

* Manage database\-level access control, including granting and revoking SQL permissions.
* Support integration of identity groups with database systems.


6\. Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) Management  

* Configure and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, and IAM components.
* Monitor cloud utilization and implement cost optimization measures.
* Perform scheduled backups, scaling, and disaster recovery support activities.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and application\-level issues within cloud environments.
* Integrate cloud services with on\-premises and third\-party systems.


7\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting  

* Diagnose and resolve system performance issues, IIS services, hardware concerns, and access\-related issues.
* Manage service configurations, permissions, and software installations.
* Support authentication\-related issues including MFA resets and monitoring tool components.


8\. AI Enablement in NOC Operations  

* Utilize AI tools to support operational efficiency in incident analysis and reporting.
* Perform summarization of alerts, logs, and incident data for operational insights.
* Develop structured prompts for root cause analysis, escalation notes, and customer communications.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs before operational use.
* Ensure adherence to data security and confidentiality standards when using AI tools.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in System Administration or NOC operations.
* Experience with monitoring tools..
* Strong knowledge of networking concepts including VPNs, tunnels, and ASA configurations.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SQL, and server administration practices.
* Ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast\-paced, 24/7 operational environment.

### **Preferred Skills:**


Technical Expertise:
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, systems, and cloud technologies.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for stakeholder interaction.
* Adherence to processes, documentation standards, and compliance requirements.

Analytical:
* Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with internal and external teams.

### **Work Environment:**

* Hybrid work model (Work From Office / Work From Home).
* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts and weekends.
* Availability outside standard business hours based on operational requirements.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**



* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
  


PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


Engineer 2, IS Solutions Database Administration responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise database environments. You will administer and monitor database platforms, develop and maintain SSIS and SSRS solutions, troubleshoot performance issues, implement backup and recovery processes, and support application teams with database\-related needs. title: Spec-Prog & Proj Mgmt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and experienced Senior SAM Flexera Specialist with a strong track record in end\-to\-end Publisher Management. You will be responsible for executing the daily lifecycle management software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive initial publisher onboarding, translate software contracts, continuously manage deployment data to maintain accurate Effective License Positions (ELPs), and identify continuous cost optimization opportunities across the software estate.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Executing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of software publishers within Flexera, from hands\-on initial onboarding through ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Interpreting EULAs, Master Services Agreements (MSAs), and purchase histories to accurately build and maintain license records and product use rights (PUR) in Flexera.
* Producing and updating defensible, audit\-ready ELP reports for managed publishers by reconciling entitlements against actual software installations and usage.
* Actively identifying software optimization opportunities by flagging shelfware, over\-licensed applications, and unmanaged installations to drive continuous cost savings.
* Normalizing raw inventory, application catalog items, and software signatures utilizing Technopedia and Flexera's recognition engines.
* Monitoring Flexera Beacon servers, inventory agent deployments, inventory alerts, and data processing jobs to ensure daily platform health.
* Supporting ecosystem integrations between Flexera and external tools, including ServiceNow CMDB, SaaS APIs, and secondary discovery sources .
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a highly analytical thinker with a deep, hands\-on understanding of software asset management tools and publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent technical and problem\-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to maintaining data accuracy and uncovering cost savings. You thrive in a highly integrated data environment and are passionate about operational excellence.


You'll need to have:

* 5 to 7 years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 3\+ years of dedicated hands\-on experience using Flexera.
* Proven track record in executing end\-to\-end publisher management, successfully onboarding and continuously managing software publishers within Flexera.
* Strong understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Adobe, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat).
* Solid operational knowledge of ecosystem integrations, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, and discovery agent data flows.
* Advanced data analysis skills utilizing Excel and relational database logic to manage and synthesize complex software entitlement data sets.


Even better if you have one or more of the following:

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate repetitive data management tasks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
